Description: Uncovered a JSON Web Token, which may lead to unauthorized access to web applications and sensitive user data.
Author: Markese Raley
Message:
proof: live app→telemetry→detection loop + real DevSecOps scanner output

LIVE LOOP (was: app only syntax-checked):
- ran the REAL app (uvicorn), drove it over HTTP via scripts/live_attack.py
- captured real vulnerable responses (IDOR leaked a $1,200 payout, SQLi UNION, SSRF->IMDS,
  copilot leaked signing-key alias) in evidence/live-attack/transcript.md
- the app's own telemetry (57 events) fired KP-0010/11/13/14/15/16/41 -> evidence/live-attack/detection-run.txt

REAL SCANNERS (was: findings hand-authored):
- gitleaks 8.18.4: 8 findings raw -> 0 after .gitleaks.toml allowlist (added useDefault + AWS-key demo)
- bandit: 5 SAST findings (SQLi/hardcoded-secret/SSRF) — fixed self-inflicted '# nosec-lab' suppression
- pip-audit: 7 real CVEs in app deps (starlette via outdated fastapi pin) -> VM-13; demo pin +2
- detect-secrets: 3 decoys; all committed under devsecops/scan-results/ with a summary README
- CI updated to run bandit + detect-secrets; Makefile run-app/live-attack/scan targets; README claims updated

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Message:

- Checkov scan: 41 IaC failures + 1 hardcoded secret (real evidence in evidence/logs/checkov-run.txt)
- identity/graph/attack_paths.py (networkx): 7 attack paths to crown jewels -> 0 after least-privilege (7 eliminated)
- cloud + identity assessments tie IaC findings -> attack paths -> CloudTrail detections -> incident

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Markese Raley
Message:
Phase 2: Kestrel Pay range - vulnerable FastAPI API + LLM copilot, nginx, compose, seeder, lab-vs-enterprise doc

- Intentionally vulnerable endpoints (IDOR, SQLi, SSRF, JWT alg=none, BEC, bulk export, prompt injection)
- KESTREL_HARDENED=1 remediation toggle for retest phase
- Structured JSONL telemetry (normalized schema) as detection data source
- Standalone stdlib seeder builds synthetic DB + benign baseline telemetry
- docker-compose with mem/cpu caps for 8GB host; one profile at a time
- Light checks passed: py_compile clean, seeder produced 40 benign events + DB
